title: Reinstatement Balance Worksheet — Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The reinstatement payment on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record whose plan services are suspended is worked out from the rules and site-care statement.

**Reinstatement balance.** The reinstatement balance is every charge on the plan record's statement, being its plan fees, self-help charges, repeat-violation charges, pet registration fees and vehicle permit fees, less every payment and waiver posted to it.

**Reinstatement payment.** The reinstatement payment is the reinstatement balance, rounded half up to the cent.

Every charge on the statement enters the balance, whatever the date it is dated.

## Worked example

Hypothetical statement:

| Entry | Amount |
|---|---|
| Plan fees of 1 June, 1 July and 1 August | $84.00 each, $252.00 |
| Self-help charge | $105.00 |
| Pet registration fee | $25.00 |
| Payment | $84.00 |
| Waiver of the pet registration fee | $25.00 |

Charges come to $382.00; payments and waivers to $109.00. The reinstatement balance is $382.00 less $109.00, which is $273.00, and the reinstatement payment is $273.00.
